steps.detail: Read instruction.md and environment/frozen/FROZEN_AXES.md. Note that the graded quantity is the verifier's own evaluation of the frozen model on the frozen held-out benchmark at update 1440, and that the corpus is the only free axis.
Read environment/tools/corpus_diversity.py and note that it is the same statistic the verifier computes, with its sha256 pinned. Plan to measure the corpus rather than to trust an exit status.

Write a generator that walks a template grid crossed with subject and modifier fillers, so coverage is structural rather than incidental, and emit exactly 480 samples in strictly ascending emission order.

Run corpus_diversity.py over the emitted corpus. Read the per-segment distinct-trigram ratios and the mode share, and confirm no segment sits below the published floor and none falls below the bound fraction of the first segment.

Run the near-duplicate check against environment/frozen/benchmark_dev.jsonl to confirm the generator is not paraphrasing evaluation material. The dev split is disjoint from the held-out split, so a clean dev reading is evidence about the generator's habits and not a licence.
Write run_report.json carrying the measured statistics, so the self-report and the verifier's recomputation can be compared instead of assumed to agree.
Confirm the generator exits zero AND that the measured profile is healthy. The exit status alone establishes nothing; that is the failure this slot is built around.
